recipe.name: P4 Walk-around
recipe.hook_formula: Point at the equipment: what the driver will actually drive, then the strongest fact.
recipe.image_prompt_template: Our tractor parked in a {setting}, three-quarter view, no text, no logos, no lettering
recipe.motion_template: A slow orbit around the tractor

es.primary_text: Emocionante oportunidad para conductores Clase A de unirse a nuestro equipo dinámico. Ofrecemos pago competitivo, excelente carga y un ambiente familiar donde valoramos a nuestros conductores. Gana $0.75 por milla. A

scores.reason: The hook slot "Great pay, great team" names no equipment and no fact, so it ignores the concept. The primary_text is built almost entirely of stock phrases ("exciting opportunity", "dynamic team", "competitive pay", "value our drivers"); only $0.75/mile is checkable, and it never says tanker, region or schedule. The Spanish is a word-for-word copy of the same filler.

The hook slot leads with the tanker and then the pay rate, exactly as the concept asks. The primary_text gives the region, three states, weekly pay, home weekends and the requirements, all checkable; "Pet policy available" is a little stiff. The Spanish reads naturally with trade words (rutas, endoso, hazmat, milla) and the same facts.

The hook slot is right: tanker, then $0.75 per mile. The primary_text leaves out the states, the regional runs, home weekends and weekly pay, uses future tense, and ends on a soft line ("let's talk"). The Spanish adds "únete al equipo hoy", which is filler and not in the English, and its headline drops the tanker.
